h2: NDT training near Dallas: college programmes, welding-inspection routes, on-the-job hiring and online study compared
html:
NDT training near Dallas: college programmes, welding-inspection routes, on-the-job hiring and online study compared

Type "NDT training near me" in Dallas and the results rarely say what is actually on offer locally. For this page we checked public college catalogues and found no full NDT certificate or degree inside Dallas County. The nearest public NDT programme is across the Metroplex at Tarrant County College in Fort Worth, a private welding school in Irving teaches welding inspection, and a large share of Dallas technicians still learn the trade on the job with an inspection company. Here is what each route gives a Dallas candidate, and what it leaves out.

Who offers NDT training around Dallas?

  • Tarrant County College, Northwest Campus (Fort Worth). TCC's Nondestructive Inspection, Testing and Evaluation programme leads to a 60-credit-hour AAS, with two shorter Level 1 certificates (NDT Technician and Radiography Technician) and non-credit courses in eddy current, penetrant and magnetic particle, radiography and ultrasound. Classes meet in person on weekday mornings, Monday to Thursday, and each course comes round on a two-year rotation, so a career advisor maps out your start. You get bench time across UT, ET, RT, MT and PT; you do not leave certified, because the college itself says certification is managed by the employer.
  • Tulsa Welding School, Dallas Metro campus in Irving. Its AAS in Welding Inspection and Quality Management builds welding codes, inspection procedures and metallurgy on top of the school's Professional Welder programme, with morning or evening classes. It suits a welder aiming at weld inspection. The programme description does not list individual NDT methods, so ask how many hours of UT, MT or PT bench work it includes.
  • On-the-job training. Inspection and testing companies across Dallas–Fort Worth hire assistants who move equipment, help with set-ups and log experience hours under a Level II. You earn while you learn, but the classroom hours a Dallas employer's written practice calls for still have to be completed and recorded somewhere.
  • ASNT North Texas Section. ASNT lists four sections in Texas, and North Texas is the one serving the Metroplex. Section meetings are the easiest way for a Dallas newcomer to meet working Level IIIs and the people who hire.
  • ASNT central exams. Dallas candidates who want ASNT 9712 or ASNT NDT Level II or III certification, rather than certification by an employer, book computer-based and practical exams at ASNT Houston, the society's testing site on Gemini Street; walk-in testing is not offered.

Which Dallas route fits you?

Your situationRoute that usually fitsWhat to watch
No NDT job yet and free on weekday morningsA TCC certificate or the AASThe drive to the Northwest Campus and the two-year course rotation
Welder moving toward inspectionThe Irving welding-inspection degree, or CWI exam prep plus VT and MT method trainingCWI and the NDT methods are separate credentials with separate exams
Working technician adding a method or a levelOnline theory with the practical at your employerThe training record must match your employer's written practice
Dallas employer certifying a crewOn-site training, a written practice and Level III-administered examsWho writes, administers and grades the general, specific and practical exams

Questions to ask any NDT training provider near Dallas

  • Hours. How many classroom hours does the course give for each method and level, and do they meet the SNT-TC-1A recommendation for your target? The SNT-TC-1A hours planner shows the numbers.
  • The practical. Who runs it, on which instruments, and on specimens with real discontinuities or only reference blocks?
  • Certification. Who certifies you at the end? Under SNT-TC-1A a Dallas employer does that under its own written practice; ASNT certifies only after its own exams.
  • Acceptance. Will the record list method, level, topics, hours and instructor, so that a hiring company in Irving or Grand Prairie can accept it without retraining you?
  • Level III access. Can you put technical questions to an ASNT NDT Level III while you study?
  • Radiography. If RT is your goal, Texas state radiographer requirements administered by DSHS sit on top of any NDT course a Dallas provider sells.

Where Atlantis fits for Dallas candidates and employers

Atlantis NDT has no classroom in Dallas. Method theory is studied online on the Atlantis portal at whatever hour suits your shift, with an ASNT NDT Level III answering course questions, and access opens on the day you enrol. Instrument set-up and scanning are rehearsed in the Practical NDT simulator; the hands-on practical and the practical exam then take place at your employer's own facility, on its equipment, under a written practice built on SNT-TC-1A, and certification is your employer's decision. Start with NDT Level 1 training, or NDT Level 2 training if you already hold Level I; many DFW field roles are built on UT, MT and PT.

This route suits someone already working for an inspection company, plant or fabricator in the Metroplex. If you have no NDT employer yet and want supervised lab hours, the TCC programme gives you that, and the online theory can run alongside it. Welders heading for weld inspection can add the six-day AWS CWI exam prep for Dallas. Nearby pages: NDT training in Fort Worth, Oklahoma City and the Texas state page.
